import math
R=math.radians
D=math.degrees
def wrap(a):
    while a>math.pi: a-=2*math.pi
    while a<-math.pi: a+=2*math.pi
    return a
P0=(-5.9,-6.15)
U=(math.cos(R(-115)),math.sin(R(-115)))
S={'x':0.0,'y':0.0,'th':0.0,'n':0,'corners':[],'woke':False,'stop':False,'pts':[],'age':0}
def wk(msg):
    if not S['woke']:
        S['woke']=True
        try: wake(msg)
        except Exception: pass
def cgap(dl,cx,cy,pts):
    near=[p for p in pts if math.hypot(p[0]-cx,p[1]-cy)<1.3]
    if not near: return True,9.0
    mx=sum(p[0] for p in near)/len(near); my=sum(p[1] for p in near)/len(near)
    if len(near)>=2:
        sxx=sum((p[0]-mx)**2 for p in near); syy=sum((p[1]-my)**2 for p in near); sxy=sum((p[0]-mx)*(p[1]-my) for p in near)
        a=0.5*math.atan2(2*sxy,sxx-syy)
        n=(-math.sin(a),math.cos(a))
    else:
        dd=math.hypot(mx-cx,my-cy) or 1.0
        n=((mx-cx)/dd,(my-cy)/dd)
    if n[0]*(mx-1.3)+n[1]*my<0: n=(-n[0],-n[1])
    gap=n[0]*(mx-cx)+n[1]*(my-cy)
    w=-math.tan(R(dl))/2.75
    vx=-1.0-w*cy; vy=w*cx
    nv=n[0]*vx+n[1]*vy
    return nv<=0.6*(gap-0.05),gap
def control(obs):
    S['n']+=1
    dt=obs.get('dt') or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; dl=R(obs['steer_deg'])
    th=S['th']
    S['x']+=v*math.cos(th)*dt; S['y']+=v*math.sin(th)*dt; S['th']+=v*math.tan(dl)/2.75*dt
    th=S['th']; c=math.cos(th); s=math.sin(th)
    def tow(p): return (S['x']+c*p[0]-s*p[1], S['y']+s*p[0]+c*p[1])
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']; rig=obs['rig']
    sgz=rig.get('screen_gaze_deg') or -23
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front') or 3.6
    vhw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width') or 0.925
    vr=vf-4.6
    hx,hy=rig['hitch']; rxv,ryv=rig['trailer_rear']
    tvx=rxv-hx; tvy=ryv-hy; tl=math.hypot(tvx,tvy) or 1.0
    tvx/=tl; tvy/=tl
    ax,ay=tow((rxv-0.9*tvx,ryv-0.9*tvy)); rx,ry=tow((rxv,ryv))
    at=math.atan2(tvy,tvx)
    psi=th+at
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    pts=[]; tr_close=False
    for k,vw in views.items():
        try:
            o=vw['origin']
            for b,dd in vw.get('walls') or []:
                pts.append((o[0]+dd*math.cos(R(b)), o[1]+dd*math.sin(R(b))))
                if k=='camera':
                    a=R(b)-at
                    beh=dd*math.cos(a); lat=dd*math.sin(a)
                    if 0<beh<0.35 and abs(lat)<0.95: tr_close=True
            for cn in vw.get('target_corners') or []:
                b=cn[0]; dd=cn[1]
                wp=tow((o[0]+dd*math.cos(R(b)), o[1]+dd*math.sin(R(b))))
                hit=False
                for q in S['corners']:
                    if math.hypot(q[0]-wp[0],q[1]-wp[1])<1.0:
                        q[0]=0.7*q[0]+0.3*wp[0]; q[1]=0.7*q[1]+0.3*wp[1]; q[2]+=1; hit=True; break
                if not hit: S['corners'].append([wp[0],wp[1],1])
        except Exception:
            pass
    if pts: S['pts']=pts; S['age']=0
    else:
        S['age']+=1
        if S['age']<6: pts=S['pts']
    rem=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('remaining',20)
    cs=sorted([q for q in S['corners'] if q[2]>=3],key=lambda q:-q[2])[:4]
    P=P0; UU=U; Ld=3.5; speed=-0.32; mode='path'
    if len(cs)==4 and rem<12:
        cx=sum(q[0] for q in cs)/4; cy=sum(q[1] for q in cs)/4
        sxx=sum((q[0]-cx)**2 for q in cs); syy=sum((q[1]-cy)**2 for q in cs); sxy=sum((q[0]-cx)*(q[1]-cy) for q in cs)
        ang=0.5*math.atan2(2*sxy,sxx-syy)
        ub=(math.cos(ang),math.sin(ang))
        dp=ub[0]*U[0]+ub[1]*U[1]
        if dp<0: ub=(-ub[0],-ub[1]); dp=-dp
        if dp<0.8: ub=U
        hl=max(abs((q[0]-cx)*ub[0]+(q[1]-cy)*ub[1]) for q in cs)
        P=(cx,cy); UU=ub; Ld=2.5; mode='bay'
        sb=ub[0]*(cx-rx)+ub[1]*(cy-ry)+hl
        speed=-max(0.25,min(0.4,0.3*sb))
        if sb<0.15:
            speed=0.0
            wk('at bay back line, leg not ended sb=%.2f phi=%.1f'%(sb,phi))
    t=(ax-P[0])*UU[0]+(ay-P[1])*UU[1]+Ld
    tx=P[0]+t*UU[0]; ty=P[1]+t*UU[1]
    psid=math.atan2(ty-ay,tx-ax)
    e=wrap(psid-psi)
    lim=32 if mode=='path' else 20
    pdes=max(-lim,min(lim,-1.3*D(e)))
    ff=D(math.atan(0.75*math.sin(R(pdes))))
    st=ff+2.5*(phi-pdes)
    if phi<-42: st=-34
    if phi>42: st=34
    st=max(-34,min(34,st))
    crn=[(vf,vhw),(vf,-vhw),(vr,vhw),(vr,-vhw)]
    def ok(d):
        g=9.0
        for (cx_,cy_) in crn:
            o_,gg=cgap(d,cx_,cy_,pts)
            g=min(g,gg)
            if not o_: return False,g
        return True,g
    good,gmin=ok(st)
    guarded=False
    if not good:
        best=None
        for d in range(-34,35,2):
            if ok(d)[0] and (best is None or abs(d-st)<abs(best-st)): best=d
        if best is None:
            S['stop']=True; wk('no safe steer, gap=%.2f phi=%.1f'%(gmin,phi))
        else:
            st=float(best); guarded=True
    if tr_close:
        S['stop']=True; wk('trailer rear close to wall phi=%.1f'%phi)
    if abs(phi)>47:
        S['stop']=True; wk('hitch too large %.1f'%phi)
    if S['stop']: speed=0.0
    if S['n']%10==0:
        print('t=%.1f %s rem=%.1f car(%.2f,%.2f,%.0f) psi=%.0f psid=%.0f phi=%.1f pdes=%.1f st=%.1f g=%d gap=%.2f v=%.2f nc=%d'%(obs['t'],mode,rem,S['x'],S['y'],D(th),D(psi),D(psid),phi,pdes,st,guarded,gmin,v,len(cs)))
    return (st,speed,sgz)

import math
X=0.0;Y=0.0;YAW=0.0
mode='FWD';tick=0;woke=False;last_touch=None;ef=0.0
C0=(-10.9,9.6);U=(-0.68,0.73);N=(0.73,0.68)
def wrap(a):
    return (a+180.0)%360.0-180.0
def clamp(v,a):
    return max(-a,min(a,v))
def control(obs):
    global X,Y,YAW,mode,tick,woke,last_touch,ef
    tick+=1
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    YAW+=v/2.5*math.tan(math.radians(st))*dt
    X+=v*math.cos(YAW)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(YAW)*dt
    c=math.cos(YAW); s=math.sin(YAW)
    hitch=obs['hitch_deg']
    t=obs['t']
    look=64 if (int(t/2.0)%2==0) else -64
    tc=obs['counters']['touches']
    if last_touch is None: last_touch=tc
    if tc>last_touch:
        last_touch=tc; mode='STOP'
        wake('touch, stopped')
    if mode=='STOP':
        return (0.0,0.0,look)
    if mode=='FWD':
        if X>=2.0 and abs(hitch)<5:
            mode='REV'
        else:
            return (clamp(-0.8*hitch,30),0.8,look)
    rig=obs['rig']; hx,hy=rig['hitch']; rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    Rw=(X+rx*c-ry*s, Y+rx*s+ry*c)
    psi=YAW+math.atan2(ry-hy,rx-hx)
    sp=U[0]*(Rw[0]-C0[0])+U[1]*(Rw[1]-C0[1])
    lat=N[0]*(Rw[0]-C0[0])+N[1]*(Rw[1]-C0[1])
    L=5.0
    aim=(C0[0]+U[0]*(sp+L),C0[1]+U[1]*(sp+L))
    aa=math.atan2(aim[1]-Rw[1],aim[0]-Rw[0])
    e=wrap(math.degrees(aa-psi))
    ef+=0.4*(e-ef)
    phi_des=clamp(-1.2*ef,30.0)
    ph=math.radians(hitch)
    ff=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(ph)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(ph))))
    steer=clamp(ff+2.0*(hitch-phi_des),45.0)
    if tick%20==0:
        print('t=%.1f R=(%.1f,%.1f) s=%.1f lat=%.1f e=%.0f hitch=%.1f phd=%.1f st=%.1f'%(t,Rw[0],Rw[1],sp,lat,e,hitch,phi_des,steer))
    if sp>0.0 and not woke:
        woke=True; wake('reached end of planned line s=%.1f'%sp)
    return (steer,-0.5,look)

args.code:
import math
L=3.9;A=0.35;LT=10.2
X=0.0;Y=0.0;TH=0.0
last_t=None
pts={}
clusters=[]
tgt=None
mode='rev'
fwd_x=None;fwd_y=None;fwd_len=3.0
touch0=0
hdes_f=0.0
cprev=0.0
dir_f=None
tick=0
warned=0

def wrap(a):
    return (a+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi

def tow(px,py):
    c=math.cos(TH);s=math.sin(TH)
    return X+px*c-py*s, Y+px*s+py*c

def tov(wx,wy):
    dx=wx-X;dy=wy-Y;c=math.cos(TH);s=math.sin(TH)
    return dx*c+dy*s, -dx*s+dy*c

def clamp(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def add_corner(wx,wy):
    for cl in clusters:
        if math.hypot(cl[0]-wx,cl[1]-wy)<1.5:
            n=cl[2]
            cl[0]=(cl[0]*n+wx)/(n+1);cl[1]=(cl[1]*n+wy)/(n+1);cl[2]=min(n+1,50)
            return
    if len(clusters)<12:
        clusters.append([wx,wy,1])

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,TH,last_t,mode,fwd_x,fwd_y,fwd_len,touch0,hdes_f,cprev,dir_f,tick,tgt,warned,pts
    tick+=1
    t=obs['t']
    dt=0.0 if last_t is None else max(0.0,t-last_t)
    last_t=t
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
    st=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])
    TH+=v*math.tan(st)/L*dt
    X+=v*math.cos(TH)*dt;Y+=v*math.sin(TH)*dt
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for name,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        ox,oy=vw['origin']
        for w in vw.get('walls',[]) or []:
            b=math.radians(w[0]);d=w[1]
            wx,wy=tow(ox+d*math.cos(b),oy+d*math.sin(b))
            pts[(round(wx/0.25),round(wy/0.25))]=(wx,wy,t)
        for c in vw.get('target_corners',[]) or []:
            try:
                b=math.radians(c[0]);d=c[1]
                wx,wy=tow(ox+d*math.cos(b),oy+d*math.sin(b))
                add_corner(wx,wy)
            except Exception:
                pass
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
        e=obs['rig']['eye'];b=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']);d=tg['dist_m']
        wx,wy=tow(e[0]+d*math.cos(b),e[1]+d*math.sin(b))
        if tgt is None: tgt=[wx,wy]
        else: tgt=[0.8*tgt[0]+0.2*wx,0.8*tgt[1]+0.2*wy]
    if tick%20==0:
        pts={k:p for k,p in pts.items() if t-p[2]<30}
    rig=obs['rig']
    rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    RX,RY=tow(rx,ry)
    tback=TH+math.radians(rig['trailer_heading_deg'])+math.pi
    look=-41
    status=obs.get('status')
    touches=obs['counters']['touches']
    # forward recovery trigger
    if mode=='rev':
        trig=None
        if touches>touch0: trig='touch'
        elif status=='JACKKNIFED' or abs(h)>52: trig='fold'
        if trig:
            mode='fwd';fwd_x=X;fwd_y=Y;fwd_len=3.5 if trig=='fold' else 3.0
            print('fwd',trig,round(t,1),round(h,1))
            if trig=='touch':
                try: wake('touch at t=%.1f h=%.1f'%(t,h))
                except Exception: pass
    touch0=touches
    if mode=='fwd':
        front=rig['vehicle_front'];hw=rig['vehicle_half_width']
        blocked=False
        for p in pts.values():
            vx,vy=tov(p[0],p[1])
            if front<vx<front+1.5 and abs(vy)<hw+0.4: blocked=True;break
        if math.hypot(X-fwd_x,Y-fwd_y)>=fwd_len or blocked or (abs(h)<8 and math.hypot(X-fwd_x,Y-fwd_y)>1.5):
            mode='rev';dir_f=None
        else:
            return (clamp(-1.0*h,-35,35),1.0,look)
    # bay mode?
    big=sorted(clusters,key=lambda c:-c[2])[:4]
    bay=None
    if len(big)==4:
        cx=sum(c[0] for c in big)/4;cy=sum(c[1] for c in big)/4
        sxx=sum((c[0]-cx)**2 for c in big);syy=sum((c[1]-cy)**2 for c in big);sxy=sum((c[0]-cx)*(c[1]-cy) for c in big)
        phi=0.5*math.atan2(2*sxy,sxx-syy)
        ux,uy=math.cos(phi),math.sin(phi)
        if (cx-RX)*ux+(cy-RY)*uy<0: ux,uy=-ux,-uy
        bay=(cx,cy,ux,uy)
    # ray evaluation
    plist=[(p[0]-RX,p[1]-RY) for p in pts.values() if abs(p[0]-RX)<16 and abs(p[1]-RY)<16]
    clr=1.7
    best=None;bestc=0;bestfree=0
    for cd in range(-55,56,5):
        a=tback+math.radians(cd);ux=math.cos(a);uy=math.sin(a)
        free=14.0
        for dx,dy in plist:
            al=dx*ux+dy*uy
            if al<=0 or al>=free: continue
            if abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)<clr: free=al
        sc=free-0.03*abs(cd-cprev)-0.01*abs(cd)
        if best is None or sc>best: best=sc;bestc=cd;bestfree=free
    cprev=bestc
    # straight-back free
    ux=math.cos(tback);uy=math.sin(tback);sfree=14.0
    for dx,dy in plist:
        al=dx*ux+dy*uy
        if 0<al<sfree and abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)<1.4: sfree=al
    want=tback+math.radians(bestc)
    spd=-min(1.2,0.3+0.12*bestfree)
    if bay is not None:
        cx,cy,bx,by=bay
        e=bx*(RY-cy)-by*(RX-cx)
        want=math.atan2(by,bx)-math.atan(e/5.0)
        spd=-0.8
    elif tgt is not None and math.hypot(tgt[0]-RX,tgt[1]-RY)<15:
        tw=math.atan2(tgt[1]-RY,tgt[0]-RX)
        d=clamp(wrap(tw-want),-math.radians(20),math.radians(20))
        want=want+d
        spd=-0.8
    elif sfree<1.6 and bestfree<2.0 and tick>30:
        mode='fwd';fwd_x=X;fwd_y=Y;fwd_len=3.0
        print('fwd close',round(t,1))
        return (clamp(-1.0*h,-35,35),1.0,look)
    if dir_f is None: dir_f=want
    else: dir_f=dir_f+0.3*wrap(want-dir_f)
    e=math.degrees(wrap(dir_f-tback))
    hd=clamp(1.3*e,-38,38)
    step=1.5
    hdes_f=hdes_f+clamp(hd-hdes_f,-step,step)
    hr=math.radians(hdes_f)
    deq=math.degrees(math.atan(L*math.sin(hr)/(LT-A*math.cos(hr))))
    steer=clamp(deq+1.5*(h-hdes_f),-42,42)
    if abs(h)>20: spd=max(spd,-0.7)
    # cab check
    front=rig['vehicle_front'];hw=rig['vehicle_half_width']
    for p in pts.values():
        vx,vy=tov(p[0],p[1])
        if -1.5<vx<front+0.3 and abs(vy)<hw+0.35:
            if t-warned>3:
                print('cab near wall',round(t,1),round(vx,1),round(vy,1));warned=t
            break
    if tick%30==0:
        print('t%.0f h%.0f hd%.0f c%d free%.1f bay%s tgt%s'%(t,h,hdes_f,bestc,bestfree,bay is not None,tgt is not None))
    return (steer,spd,look)

    dx=wx-X;dy=wy-Y;c=math.cos(TH);s=math.sin(TH)
    return dx*c+dy*s, -dx*s+dy*c
def clamp(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))
def add_corner(wx,wy):
    for cl in clusters:
        if math.hypot(cl[0]-wx,cl[1]-wy)<1.5:
            n=cl[2]
            cl[0]=(cl[0]*n+wx)/(n+1);cl[1]=(cl[1]*n+wy)/(n+1);cl[2]=min(n+1,50)
            return
    if len(clusters)<12:

import math
L=3.9;A=0.35;LT=10.2
X=0.0;Y=0.0;TH=0.0
last_t=None
mode='fwd'
fx=0.0;fy=0.0;flen=3.5
touch0=None
hdes_f=None
tick=0
a0=math.radians(-142.0)
ux=math.cos(a0);uy=math.sin(a0)
P0x=-12.56+0.616*2.0;P0y=-4.11-0.788*2.0

def wrap(a):
    return (a+math.pi)%(2*math.pi)-math.pi
def tow(px,py):
    c=math.cos(TH);s=math.sin(TH)
    return X+px*c-py*s, Y+px*s+py*c
def clamp(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,TH,last_t,mode,fx,fy,flen,touch0,hdes_f,tick
    tick+=1
    t=obs['t']
    dt=0.0 if last_t is None else max(0.0,t-last_t)
    last_t=t
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']
    st=math.radians(obs['steer_deg'])
    TH+=v*math.tan(st)/L*dt
    X+=v*math.cos(TH)*dt;Y+=v*math.sin(TH)*dt
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    rig=obs['rig']
    rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    pr=math.radians(rig['trailer_heading_deg'])
    RX,RY=tow(rx,ry)
    PX,PY=tow(rx+1.9*math.cos(pr),ry+1.9*math.sin(pr))
    tback=TH+pr+math.pi
    touches=obs['counters']['touches']
    if touch0 is None: touch0=touches
    if mode=='rev':
        trig=None
        if touches>touch0: trig='touch'
        elif obs.get('status')=='JACKKNIFED' or abs(h)>55: trig='fold'
        if trig:
            mode='fwd';fx=X;fy=Y;flen=3.0
            print('fwd',trig,'t%.1f h%.0f X%.1f Y%.1f TH%.0f rear(%.1f,%.1f)'%(t,h,X,Y,math.degrees(TH),RX,RY))
            try: wake('%s t=%.1f h=%.1f'%(trig,t,h))
            except Exception: pass
    touch0=touches
    if mode=='fwd':
        if math.hypot(X-fx,Y-fy)>=flen:
            mode='rev';hdes_f=h
        else:
            return (0.0,1.0,-41)
    if hdes_f is None: hdes_f=h
    el=ux*(PY-P0y)-uy*(PX-P0x)
    psi=a0-clamp(math.atan(el/7.0),-0.4,0.4)
    eh=math.degrees(wrap(psi-tback))
    hd=clamp(-1.3*eh,-40,40)
    hdes_f=hdes_f+clamp(hd-hdes_f,-1.5,1.5)
    hr=math.radians(hdes_f)
    deq=math.degrees(math.atan(L*math.sin(hr)/(LT-A*math.cos(hr))))
    steer=clamp(deq+1.5*(h-hdes_f),-42,42)
    spd=-0.6 if abs(h)>25 else -0.75
    if tick%20==0:
        print('t%.0f h%.0f hd%.0f el%.1f eh%.0f rear(%.1f,%.1f) TH%.0f'%(t,h,hdes_f,el,eh,RX,RY,math.degrees(TH)))
    return (steer,spd,-41)

What worked: on the reversing camera, fit a line to the left rail and keep the trailer parallel to it with a bit more than its width of clearance, slowly, to the end. Don't trust far bay corners. Tip: this long trailer reacts late; keep the hitch modest and correct early.
